description: This Java class implements serialization of ShareAccountBusinessEvent objects into an Avro-compatible DTO, specifically for a share account event in the Fineract project. It leverages services and mappers to retrieve share account data and convert it for external event processing.

classes.name: ShareAccountBusinessEventSerializer
classes.description: A Spring component class responsible for serializing ShareAccountBusinessEvent instances into Avro DTOs for external event transmission, implementing BusinessEventSerializer interface.

methods.name: canSerialize
methods.description: Determines whether the serializer can handle the given business event, specifically checking if it is an instance of ShareAccountBusinessEvent.

methods.name: toAvroDTO
methods.description: Converts a BusinessEvent containing ShareAccount data into an Avro serializable DTO by retrieving full account data and mapping it to the Avro schema.

methods.name: getSupportedSchema
methods.description: Returns the class type of the Avro schema supported by this serializer, which is ShareAccountDataV1.
